responseText:
Good. We'll start with the basics: a Granite weapon mold. The mold is the foundation of any weapon. Source some granite, and head over to that Stonemasons' Station. There, craft a stone weapon mold. 

Make it capacious! More metal for your mettle, if you follow me. Show me when you're done.
